title: Fund44 — More ways to fund your business.
metaTitle: Fund44 — More ways to fund your business.
metaDescription: Explore a range of small-business financing paths, including SBA options and flexible capital, with conservative marketplace and workflow disclosures.
summary: Fund44 turns a fragmented financing search into a more organized comparison experience so small-business owners can explore relevant funding paths without unsupported promises about outcomes or timing.

hero.title: More ways to fund your business.
hero.lead: Explore SBA loans, acquisition financing, term loans, and lines of credit through a clearer comparison experience designed to explain the relevant paths in plain language.

problem.eyebrow: The problem with shopping for capital
problem.heading: Funding a business shouldn't mean starting over five times.
problem.lead: Every lender wants a slightly different application and its own documents. Fund44 is designed to make comparing financing paths more organized.

network.heading: Your profile, routed through a curated network.
network.lead: Fund44 launched with 44 lenders. That number is behind the name and remains the operating sweet spot for the network. Today Fund44 curates a network that typically fluctuates between 40 and 50 lenders as it removes providers that fall short of its customer-service standards and adds providers that offer competitive terms, better tools, or new financing options. The network can change over time, and the paths shown in the experience may vary by business profile, financing need, geography, and current provider participation.

featureItems.title: Guided path review
featureItems.description: The experience is designed to make path review easier and reduce unnecessary backtracking.

featureItems.title: Explain the fit
featureItems.description: Fund44 is built around fit over fees. The experience explains why a path may fit based on the information provided, the stated financing need, and the product details available in the experience.

featureItems.title: Clear comparisons
featureItems.description: See why a financing path may suit your use of funds, amount, and business profile based on the details available in the experience.

workflow.heading: One document checklist, status tracking, and offer comparison when available.
workflow.lead: Fund44 is designed for a faster process, with routing explanations, one document checklist, document reuse where supported in the workflow, status tracking, and offer comparison when those steps are available in the experience. Exact timing, available paths, and workflow details can vary by provider and by business profile.
workflow.portalLead: This illustrative checklist shows how one document list and status visibility can organize a financing review. Available steps can vary by provider and by business profile.

portalFeatures.title: One document checklist
portalFeatures.description: One checklist can organize the common materials requested in the workflow.

portalFeatures.title: Status visibility
portalFeatures.description: A clear timeline can be shown when those steps are available in the experience.

workflow.comparisonLead: When offer-comparison steps are available in the experience, Fund44 is designed to line them up so you can weigh structure and fit in plain language.

comparisonFeatures.title: Offer comparison
comparisonFeatures.description: Compare structures side by side when that step is available in the experience.

comparisonFeatures.title: Decide with context
comparisonFeatures.description: Understand what each path means before you proceed with any provider.

status.heading: Plain-language explanations, without guarantees.
status.lead: The experience explains why a path may fit and what step comes next based on the details available in the workflow, while avoiding promises about outcomes, timing, or provider behavior.
status.disclosureHtml: Fund44 is not a lender. Fund44 does not guarantee approval, funding, or any specific timeline, rate, or amount. Checking the preview uses information that does not affect your credit score because the current preview does not submit an application to a lender.

quickAnswer.definition: is a small-business financing experience that helps owners explore selected financing paths with clearer comparison guidance. Fund44 is not a lender.

howFund44Fits.heading: How Fund44 fits
howFund44Fits.summary: The home page explains the marketplace story, curated network, and conservative workflow language without promising outcomes or timing.
bullets: Introduces the approved 44-lender origin story through the centralized network disclosure.
Reuses the approved fit-over-fees and faster-process disclosure language.
Routes visitors into financing pages, the learning hub, or the preview flow.

commonQuestions.question: Is Fund44 a lender?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Fund44 is not a lender. Financing availability, eligibility, rates, and terms are determined by third-party providers.

commonQuestions.question: What size funding does Fund44 help with?
commonQuestions.answer: Fund44 helps owners explore selected financing paths. Exact path availability can vary by provider, business profile, financing need, geography, and current provider participation.

commonQuestions.question: Does checking my options affect my credit?
commonQuestions.answer: Checking the preview uses information that does not affect your credit score because the current preview does not submit an application to a lender.

commonQuestions.question: What products can I be matched to?
commonQuestions.answer: Coverage can include SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans, business acquisition financing, conventional term loans, business lines of credit, equipment financing, and invoice factoring, depending on your profile, financing need, and provider availability.

commonQuestions.question: Do I have to apply separately with each lender?
commonQuestions.answer: The current experience is designed to help you compare paths before you proceed with any provider. Workflow details, document reuse, and next steps can vary by provider and by business profile.

ctaBanner.heading: Preview funding paths for your business.
ctaBanner.subheading: Preview only. This flow shows sample results, does not create an application, and does not send your information to a lender or server in the current build.
